selected.why: Captures high-intent non-converting users immediately after dismissing the Janitor Plus paywall modal (s04) with a micro-taste of frontier model swipes, driving sampling without cannibalizing the monthly subscription.

Directly resolves the user's immediate barrier on the memory limit paywall screen (s03) with a 30-minute time-boxed unlock of the 5x context memory entitlement while keeping full permanent memory gated.

Introduces a non-intrusive proactive daily retention loop directly within the Profile menu (s02), granting a capped daily allowance of frontier swipes without degrading the existing unlimited free tier.

proposals.title: Paywall Fallback Swipes
proposals.oneLiner: Provide non-paying users with limited base model swipes in exchange for engagement when they decline a premium paywall.

newMechanic.name: Base Model Swipes
newMechanic.description: A new consumable resource allowing limited interactions with a cheaper, base AI model. These are tracked per user, refresh daily, and are distinct from premium 'frontier model swipes'.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: To provide a valuable, low-cost rewarded item to non-paying users as an alternative to direct subscription, without cannibalizing the core premium offering.

proposals.trigger: Fires immediately after the user taps the decline option ('Close paywall' on s03 or 'Not now' on s04) on either Janitor Plus paywall.
proposals.eligibility: Non-paying, non-subscribed users who dismiss the premium subscription offer from s03 or s04.

offer.title: Want 3 free swipes?
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second game to get 3 free swipes on our base models.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: The offer is gated purely on paywall decline (TAX-10). It is strictly capped at 2 instances (6 swipes) per day, ensuring the premium subscription's 'generous monthly swipes' promise remains a far superior, frictionless option. Rewards a cheaper 'base model swipe' instead of premium 'frontier model swipes'.

guardrails: Paywall s03 and s04 purchase conversion rate
kpis.holdout: Run a 5% user-level holdout group for 28 days to measure downstream subscription cannibalization and net revenue lift.

risks: Slight risk of micro-cannibalization among users who only need a couple of extra swipes per day, mitigated by the low daily cap.
Potential fatigue if users repeatedly see the offer on every paywall dismissal, mitigated by the 12-hour cooldown.

offer.title: Boost Memory for 30 Minutes
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second game for 30 minutes of 5x context.

reward.what: 30 minutes of 5x context for better memory

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: Gated exclusively to paywall decliners at m2 and time-boxed to 30 minutes [TAX-2] [CANN-1]. The full Janitor Plus plan (of1) retains permanent 5x context, priority routing, and golden badge status.

kpis.primary: Rewarded ad revenue per DAU from paywall decliners
guardrails: Janitor Plus subscription conversion rate (non-inferiority margin -2%)

risks: The average inference COGS for providing 30 minutes of 5x context using a cheaper model must be sustainable. We assume a 'text-cheap' model for the trial, which significantly lowers the cost per minute of enhanced context compared to the full premium subscription model, making the estimated COGS per view approximately $0.003-$0.005, which is below the low-end net revenue per view [TRIG-4].
Overuse could slightly delay subscription conversion for heavy chatters if capped too loosely [CANN-2].
